[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Chiloven945/vMessageRecord?style=flat-square&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,&logoSize=auto&label=Stars&labelColor=444444&color=eac54f)](https://github.com/Chiloven945/vMessageRecord/)

Hi. This is a small "add-on" for szymon-off's Velocity plugin [vMessage](https://github.com/szymon-off/vMessage), which
can record players' activities like public messages, private messages, and join/leave messages in .csv files or to
databases. Helpful if you want to spy on your players, isn't it?

This plugin is written for my own server, but Pull Requests and issues reporting are still welcomed!
